Actual Article Body:
Katie Zacharia will appear in the White House briefing room on Tuesday morning for the first time as President Donald Trump’s press secretary. She plans to stick around.

She told Secrets that she intends to stay in the role until the end of the president’s term, which is more than two years away and would beat the previous record for a press secretary under Trump.
